text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, there is a tree-cover loss candidate on the property after 2020. A tree-cover loss event of 13.5 hectares was observed in 2025 within the asset boundary. However, this observation is pending corroboration, meaning that further evidence from subsequent years is needed to confirm the persistence of this change. The cause, legality, and compliance of the change cannot be determined from the current data.
